title: MLINE-referenced LTYPE APPID and XDATA provider

scope.source: Runtime-generated MLINE authority recipe; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.
scope.appid_provider: MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA, source APPID handle 0x1F1, owned by the source APPID table at 0x1F0; flags 0 and no optional metadata.

proof.source: Physical source fields and fresh read show the exact ordered LTYPE XDATA pair and one APPID provider. Import-time resource origin, raw/typed equality, the LTYPE AppIdName role, and APPID name lookup bind the dependency.
proof.output: The staged TABLES inspector requires one selected APPID row in table 9 with owner 9, exact common fields and decoded model equality. It checks the selected LTYPE physical body and XDATA order, decoded LTYPE equality, unique names/handles, and fresh readback of the APPID and payload.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the source APPID from the live model refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late APPID-name mutation after its writer callback also refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the source name permits same-adapter retry.

limits: This is one selected AC1027 transport profile: exactly one 1001 APPID followed by one 1000 string, with a bare source-bound APPID provider. Other XDATA group codes, multiple APPID groups, APPID metadata, other LTYPE schemas, versions and native semantics remain unqualified.
The receipt does not establish native XDATA application behavior, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
